title: PhabLens Annotation Mapping
description: Annotation mappings loaded by PhabLens to mark and cross-reference lines in a Phabricator diff.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this schema. PhabLens ignores this field.

annotations.description: Ordered annotations. The zero-based array index is shown as the annotation number in the gutter and lens.

category.description: How to interpret the annotation. ported/inlined/merged/split are clickable when both sides are present; new and removed usually have one side.

group.description: Optional theme or section label shown in the annotation lens. Use it to cluster related mappings.

from.description: Optional old-side source range. In side-by-side Phabricator diffs this corresponds to the left/original side.

to.description: Optional new-side target range. In side-by-side Phabricator diffs this corresponds to the right/changed side.

comment.description: Optional explanation shown in hover text and in the lens. Keep it concise enough to scan during review.

file.description: File path exactly as displayed in the Phabricator changeset header.

lines.description: Inclusive one-based line range [start, end] for this side of the diff.

name.description: Optional symbol, function, class, section, or short label shown in the lens.
